title: Record one signed full-support n=8 parity prefix at 23/16 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

For the `n = 8` symbol `(1, 1/8, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16, -1/16)`, every proper prefix has infinity norm at most `3/2`. The largest proper prefix is `23/16`. The right shear alone is `2521/2048`, the next four proper prefixes are `5/4`, and the next five are `21/16`. The completed product has infinity norm `3/2`. This is the signed full-support step left open by #4811. The branch is from fetched main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43` and does not replay that open package.

The tail `l1` is `1/2`. The schedule applies the right shear, then the even child, then the Schur child, then the left shear, and repeats that order inside every child. There are 22 factors and 21 proper prefixes. The quotient is `(1/8, 7/128, 105/2048, -2521/32768)`. The right shear drops the last quotient entry, so its bottom row is `1 + 1/8 + 7/128 + 105/2048 = 2521/2048`, the same opening value as the positive full-support symbol. The later proper prefixes are also the same: four at `5/4`, five at `21/16`, and eleven at `23/16`. The final left shear carries `-2521/32768` and is not a proper prefix. The product of the 22 factors equals the even/odd reordering of the Toeplitz matrix, whose infinity norm is `3/2`.

`2521/2048 < 5/4 < 21/16 < 23/16 < 3/2 < 9/4`. The sign changes only the last quotient entry, from the positive value `1575/32768` to `-2521/32768`. The even child stays `(1, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16)`. The Schur child stays `(1, 3/64, 49/1024, 735/16384)`. Every proper-prefix infinity norm matches the positive full-support path. Nine nontrivial factors sit in the proper prefixes.

This is one symbol. It does not bound every tail of `l1` at most `1/2`, the generator-shear compiler, the completed Gaussian stage, or the dyadic `p^100` normalizer. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/triangular-parity-signed-seven-entry`
- [x] Prints `PASS_TRIANGULAR_PARITY_SIGNED_SEVEN_ENTRY` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetches at 2026-10-22T20:29:11Z and the pre-submit fetch at 2026-10-22T20:31:33Z were that commit. The pinned blobs of `certificates/selected-result.json` (`c35482cd9035843b15a634cc8276a7e1e40e8395`), `GAUSSIAN.md` (`adfb28c93e6b06178c901caaac39ede41a9e541b`), and `vendor/SHALLOW-TOEPLITZ.md` (`bc4349b2daea548ffa09e1f38a31f1df86b0b7be`) were unchanged. κ remains `60403/20000000`.
